title: CloudTech to bring institutional-grade crypto trading to APAC investors

title: Dogecoin leads market rebound with 15% pump, bitcoin steady above $85,000

content: Dogecoin led a recent cryptocurrency market rebound with a significant 15% price surge. Meanwhile, Bitcoin remained steady, holding comfortably above the $85,000 mark. As this liquidation wave subsided, the largest cryptocurrency stabilized, leaving most major digital assets in positive territory.

title: ShredPay Joins Jack Henry Network To Bring Stablecoin Infrastructure To Banks
summary: TL;DR ShredPay has joined the Jack Henry Fintech Integration Network. The integration can connect ShredPay’s stablecoin and digital-asset services with Jack Henry institutions through jXchange and SymXchange APIs. Jack Henry serves about 7,400 banks and credit unions combined. ShredPay has joined Jack Henry’s Fintech Integration Network, opening a path for banks and credit unions on Jack Henry technology to connect with stablecoin and digital-asset services. The partnership was announced on September 21 and centers on integration rather than a blanket rollout to every Jack Henry customer. ShredPay Connects Through Jack Henry APIs ShredPay describes itself as a stablecoin and digital-asset management platform. Through the Jack Henry network, financial institutions can integrate ShredPay services using jXchange and SymXchange APIs, the interfaces used to connect fintech products with Jack Henry’s core banking systems. That matters because one of the biggest barriers to bank adoption of digital-asset infrastructure is not necessarily demand for the product itself. It is the difficulty of connecting new services to the systems institutions already use for accounts, payments, controls and reporting. The integration network is meant to reduce that friction. Jack Henry’s Reach Makes The Distribution Opportunity Meaningful Jack Henry serves approximately 7,400 financial institutions across banks and credit unions. That figure should not be read as 7,400 banks signing up for ShredPay. The announcement establishes technical and commercial access through the network; individual institutions still decide whether to adopt the service. Even so, getting into the integration layer used by a major core-banking provider can be a meaningful step for a fintech company trying to reach regulated financial institutions. Stablecoins are increasingly being discussed as payment and settlement infrastructure rather than purely crypto-native assets. ShredPay’s Jack Henry integration is another attempt to bring that infrastructure closer to conventional banking workflows. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae. Source: Primary Source
content: ShredPay has joined the Jack Henry Fintech Integration Network to provide stablecoin and digital-asset services to banks and credit unions. Using jXchange and SymXchange APIs, the integration aims to help financial institutions connect digital-asset infrastructure with existing core banking systems. Jack Henry serves approximately 7,400 financial institutions, offering ShredPay a significant pathway to reach regulated banking networks.
content_ta: ShredPay நிறுவனம் Jack Henry Fintech Integration Network-ல் இணைந்துள்ளது. இதன் மூலம் வங்கிகள் மற்றும் கிரெடிட் யூனியன்களுக்கு stablecoin மற்றும் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து சேவைகளை வழங்க முடியும். jXchange மற்றும் SymXchange API-களை பயன்படுத்தி இந்த ஒருங்கிணைப்பு செயல்படுத்தப்படுகிறது. Jack Henry சுமார் 7,400 நிதி நிறுவனங்களுக்கு சேவை அளிப்பதால், ShredPay நிறுவனத்திற்கு ஒழுங்குபடுத்தப்பட்ட வங்கி நெட்வொர்க்குகளை அடைய இது ஒரு முக்கிய வாய்ப்பாக அமைகிறது.

title: Coinbase Opens IPO Allocations To US Retail Traders Starting With Oura
summary: TL;DR Eligible US retail Coinbase customers can now request allocations in IPOs through the Coinbase app. The service is offered through FINRA-registered Coinbase Capital Markets. Oura is the first IPO on the platform, with allocation rules designed to discourage immediate flipping. Coinbase is adding initial public offerings to the list of financial products available inside its app. The exchange announced that eligible US retail customers can now request IPO allocations through Coinbase, with the service provided by Coinbase Capital Markets, its FINRA-registered broker-dealer. Oura Becomes The First IPO Available Through Coinbase The first offering available through the product is Oura. Rather than buying shares after they begin trading on the open market, eligible users can submit a Conditional Offer to Buy at the IPO offer price before public trading starts. That does not mean every request will receive shares. Allocations remain subject to availability, eligibility checks and the platform’s allocation process. Coinbase says its system is designed in part to favor longer-term participation. One of the controls is a 30-day holding incentive: users who sell allocated IPO shares within 30 days risk being locked out of IPO participation for 60 days. Coinbase Pushes Further Beyond Crypto Trading The launch is another example of Coinbase expanding its role beyond spot crypto. By putting IPO access inside the same app that customers use for digital assets, the company is moving deeper into territory traditionally occupied by retail brokerages. That does not make Coinbase an underwriter of the Oura IPO, and the company is not guaranteeing allocations to customers who submit requests. It does, however, give eligible users a new path to participate in an offering before open-market trading begins. The product is limited to customers who meet the required eligibility checks, and availability should not be described as universal across all US residents. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae. Source: Primary Source
content: Coinbase is expanding its platform by allowing eligible US retail customers to request IPO allocations directly through its app. The service is operated via Coinbase Capital Markets, with Oura being the first offering available. title: Bitwise Updates XRP ETF Prospectus In New SEC Filing
summary: TL;DR Bitwise filed a post-effective amendment updating disclosures for its XRP ETF trust. The September 21 filing registered zero new shares. The filing is a prospectus update, not an SEC approval notice or a new ETF launch. Bitwise has filed an updated prospectus for its XRP exchange-traded fund trust, adding another SEC filing to the product’s regulatory record. The September 21 submission was made on Form POS AM, a post-effective amendment used to update registration-statement disclosures. What The Bitwise XRP Filing Actually Does The filing is notable because XRP ETF paperwork continues to draw heavy attention, but the procedural status matters. Bitwise registered zero new shares in this amendment. That means the filing should not be treated as evidence that the SEC has newly approved the product, nor does it establish that a commercial launch happened on September 21. Instead, the amendment updates prospectus material tied to the trust. For investors following the ETF process, these filings can still be useful because they show that issuers are continuing to maintain and refine registration documents while regulatory and operational work progresses. XRP ETF Headlines Need Procedural Precision Crypto ETF filings often move through several stages: initial registration documents, amendments, exchange filings, effectiveness, launch preparation and eventual trading. Those stages are not interchangeable. In this case, the verified event is a Bitwise POS AM filing concerning its XRP ETF trust. The document does not support describing the fund as newly approved, and it does not show that new shares were registered in this specific filing. The broader XRP ETF story may continue to develop, but the September 21 event is best understood as a prospectus update inside that process rather than a final regulatory green light. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae. Source: Primary Source
content: Bitwise has submitted a post-effective amendment to update disclosures for its XRP ETF trust in a new SEC filing. title: New York Life Takes High-Yield Bond Strategy Onchain With Centrifuge
summary: TL;DR New York Life Investment Management is working with Centrifuge to tokenize a US high-yield corporate bond strategy. The product is being built on Avalanche with USDC subscriptions and redemptions. Access is restricted to qualified institutional buyers. New York Life Investment Management is taking one of its fixed-income strategies onchain through a partnership with Centrifuge. The firms announced plans to tokenize a US high-yield corporate bond strategy on Avalanche, with qualified institutional buyers able to subscribe and redeem using USDC. A Traditional Bond Strategy Gets Blockchain Rails The underlying idea is not to turn high-yield bonds into a retail crypto product. Instead, Centrifuge is providing tokenization infrastructure around an institutional investment strategy managed by NYLIM, which oversees more than $300 billion in assets. Using Avalanche gives the product a blockchain settlement and ownership layer, while USDC provides a digital-dollar mechanism for subscriptions and redemptions. For institutions, that can simplify some of the operational movement between cash and fund interests, particularly in markets where tokenized products are being built to operate outside traditional settlement windows. Institutional Access Remains Restricted The product is not being opened broadly to the public. The announcement specifically frames access around qualified institutional buyers, which is an important limitation when evaluating how far the tokenization reaches. What is significant is the type of asset moving onchain. Tokenized Treasury products have already become one of the clearest areas of institutional blockchain adoption. High-yield corporate bonds bring a different risk and return profile into the same infrastructure trend. With NYLIM and Centrifuge, the tokenization story is moving further into actively managed credit strategies rather than remaining centered only on cash-like government debt. The September 17 announcement therefore adds another established asset manager to the group testing how conventional investment products can be issued and serviced through public blockchain rails. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae. Source: Primary Source
content: New York Life Investment Management is partnering with Centrifuge to tokenize a US high-yield corporate bond strategy. This initiative brings traditional fixed-income assets onto public blockchain infrastructure, offering qualified institutional buyers a digital-dollar settlement mechanism.

title: Centreville Bank Selects Jack Henry to Support Continued Growth, Modernization and Enhanced Customer Experiences
summary:
Jack Henry®  announced today that Centreville Bank has selected Jack Henry to support its continued growth with scalable technology, modern capabilities, and a commitment to continuous innovation.
Founded in 1828 in West Warwick, Rhode Island, Centreville Bank is a $3 billion-asset mutual bank serving consumers and businesses through 26 locations across Rhode Island and Connecticut. The bank has grown significantly in recent years through acquisitions, geographic expansion, commercial lending, and strategic investments, while maintaining its focus on relationship banking, exceptional service, and community impact. As it approaches its 200th anniversary, Centreville Bank continues to expand its physical and digital presence to meet the evolving needs of its customers and communities.
This investment represents another step in Centreville Bank's long-term strategy to strengthen its technology, expand its capabilities, and support future growth across Rhode Island and Connecticut.
To support this strategy, Centreville Bank selected Jack Henry's core processing platform and a range of integrated solutions:
The Banno Digital Platform™ will provide advanced digital banking capabilities for both retail and business customers.
 


JHA Treasury Management™ will offer enhanced cash management capabilities for commercial clients.
 


Enterprise Workflow and Jack Henry's customer relationship management platform, Synapsys, are both new to the bank and will help automate manual processes, improve internal efficiencies, and support a more seamless customer and employee experience.
"We were looking for modern technology to support our continued growth while helping us deliver the level of service and experience our customers and employees expect," said Jillian J. DeShiro, EVP, Chief Financial and Operating Officer at Centreville Bank. "There is a lot of excitement about the opportunities this move will create for our customers, employees, and future growth. Jack Henry gives us the flexibility to add new capabilities as our customers' needs evolve and continue delivering the personalized banking experience that sets Centreville Bank apart. The strong cultural alignment and shared commitment to community banking were also deciding factors."
Several factors influenced Centreville Bank's decision, including Jack Henry's long-term technology strategy, commitment to continuous innovation, and ability to support the bank's future growth and evolving customer needs. Centreville Bank was also impressed by Jack Henry's use of workflow automation to enhance its offerings, as well as its culture, employee satisfaction, and employee longevity.
"Their commitment to innovation and continuous improvement aligns closely with our long-term goals," DeShiro added. "We've been serving our communities for nearly 200 years, and we've continued to evolve alongside the needs of our customers, from individuals and families to growing businesses and commercial clients. With Jack Henry, we're investing in technology that will grow alongside our customers, employees, and communities.”
"Centreville Bank has achieved impressive growth while staying true to its relationship-driven approach and commitment to the communities it serves," said Jonathan Baltzell, President of Bank Solutions at Jack Henry. "As the bank expands its commercial business and geographic reach, it needs technology that can scale alongside it. We're excited to support its continued momentum."

title: Wolters Kluwer Brings Its Leading Global Tax and Accounting Portfolio Brand CCH to Belgium
summary:
Wolters Kluwer Tax & Accounting today announced the  launch of CCH in Belgium, the first market in continental Europe to adopt the leading global tax  and accounting brand. The launch brings together some of Belgium’s most widely used tax and  accounting solutions under a single trusted brand. CCH is the global portfolio brand for Wolters  Kluwer Tax & Accounting. Built on the principles of Clarity, Confidence and Human-Centered  Innovation, it sets the standard for intelligent work in tax and accounting. 
"Belgium is the natural place to introduce CCH in continental Europe. Around one in three  companies here already works with one of our solutions, and Belgian accountants are among  the most digitally advanced on the continent," said Bas Kniphorst, EVP & Managing Director  of Wolters Kluwer Tax & Accounting Europe. "By bringing one of the world's most trusted tax  and accounting brands to a market where we already have deep roots, we are combining local  innovation with more than a century of global expertise to create one connected ecosystem for  accountants and their clients." 
From September, a number of well-established Wolters Kluwer solutions will adopt the CCH  name. These include CCH Clearfacts, CCH Codabox, CCH Flowin and CCH Clearnox, solutions that joined Wolters Kluwer in 2024 through the acquisition of Isabel Group’s European  accountancy portfolio. Adsolut Personenbelasting will become CCH Personal Tax. 
CCH is recognised globally and combines trusted expertise, connected workflows, cloud  technology, and AI-powered capabilities. Across the portfolio, intelligent capabilities are  delivered through Wolters Kluwer’s Expert AI layer, which is designed to augment professional  judgment. 
“In accountancy, we are seeing a clear ‘shift to the left’: invoice management and allocation are  increasingly moving into pre-accounting. By automating these processes and connecting the  entire accounting workflow, we are helping accountants accelerate their transition towards a  more strategic role as financial and compliance advisors. With CCH, accountants now have  access to a single, connected ecosystem covering the entire workflow, from pre- to core and  post-accounting. They no longer need to think about where one product ends and another  begins. Our integrated suite of cloud solutions delivers a new, connected user experience,  helping accountants stay ahead of regulatory change and digitalisation while preparing for the  growing role of AI", said said Marie Costers, VP & General Manager, Wolters Kluwer Tax &  Accounting Belgium, the Netherlands and the UK.  
As part of the transition, customers will continue to use the solutions they know today while  benefiting from a more unified portfolio aligned with Wolters Kluwer’s global vision for the future  of the profession. The launch is part of a long-term strategy to simplify customer experience and accelerate innovation across markets. It reflects Wolters Kluwer’s evolution towards cloud based and intelligent solutions and marks the first step in the broader rollout of CCH across  continental Europe.

title: EAC Managing Director Anna Feng Discusses the Rise of Super Investment Banks
summary:
Anna Feng, Managing Director of the EssentaTor Arab Capital Strategic Liquidity Fund (the “EAC Fund”), who holds a Master of Finance degree from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), delivered an address titled “The Rise of Super Investment Banks” on September 15 during the EAC Fund’s forum at Money20/20 Middle East.
 
Feng examined a structural tension facing asset managers, fund managers and wealth managers: investment conviction may extend over a decade, while the capital supporting it often operates on a much shorter cycle. That mismatch can force an institution to sell a high-quality asset before its investment thesis has fully played out, or to pass on an opportunity because its capital cannot remain invested long enough.
“Liquidity is not just capital. Liquidity is optionality,” Feng said. “It is the ability to wait, to adjust, to renew and to exit without being forced to sell a high-quality asset at the wrong time.”
Feng used the term “super investment banks” to describe an expansion of investment institutions’ capabilities rather than a change in identity. She said their competitive advantage will increasingly depend on how effectively they can organize and deploy capital across different sources, durations, risk preferences and geographies, and connect that capital with suitable assets.
She outlined three areas that can strengthen this capability: capital duration, asset structure and liquidity tools.
On capital duration, Feng said EAC seeks to help partner institutions align capital more closely with long-duration assets, potentially supporting ten-year, fifteen-year or longer horizons depending on the transaction structure. The value lies in allowing an institution to remain invested while its thesis continues to hold, rather than exiting because the capital term has expired.
On asset structure, she advocated clearer separation between reserve assets and project investments. Independently managed reserve pools, custody arrangements and layered transaction structures can help prevent project-level volatility from automatically becoming institution-level liquidity stress.
On liquidity tools, Feng said different needs require different mechanisms. Depending on the partner’s asset and transaction structure, these may include fund interest subscriptions, bridge financing, yield-bearing fund interest transactions, project acquisitions and co-investments. The objective is to give institutions more options at different stages of the investment life cycle while preserving the ability to invest for the long term.
Feng described the EAC Fund as being designed to provide institutional liquidity to asset managers, fund managers and wealth managers. She said its model is designed around a reserve-asset foundation across multiple jurisdictions, including foreign-exchange reserves, U.S. Treasury reserve assets and U.S. dollar stablecoin reserve assets. Her emphasis was on building liquidity structures that can continue to function over time, rather than treating liquidity as a one-off funding transaction.
“The institutions of the future will be those that can better align investment conviction with capital duration,” Feng said. “They will build the architecture to support both.”
Feng concluded by inviting institutions considering capital-duration constraints, liquidity structures or access to capital to continue the discussion with the EAC Fund.

ASSX Adds Leverage On Top Of A Bitcoin Treasury Stock Strive’s own balance sheet holds 26,355 BTC, making its equity sensitive to both its operating business and the market value of its Bitcoin treasury. ASSX takes that equity exposure and adds daily leverage. That is materially different from owning Bitcoin directly. It is also different from holding a spot Bitcoin ETF. The fund tracks Strive stock, not BTC, and its 2x objective resets daily. Over periods longer than one day, compounding and volatility can cause returns to diverge significantly from simply doubling Strive’s longer-term stock performance. Bitcoin Treasury Equities Keep Spawning New Products As more public companies adopt large crypto treasuries, the equities themselves are becoming building blocks for additional financial products. ASSX is an example of that second-order market. Investors who want amplified daily exposure to Strive can now access it through an exchange-traded product, but they are taking on the risks of leverage, single-stock concentration and Strive’s corporate structure at the same time. The listing should therefore be understood as a 2x leveraged ETF on ASST shares. It is not a leveraged spot-Bitcoin product, even though Bitcoin remains a major driver of the underlying company’s investment narrative. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae. Source: Primary Source
content: REX Shares has launched the T-REX 2X Long Strive Daily Target ETF under the ticker ASSX. The new fund aims to deliver 200 percent of the daily performance of Strive Asset Management stock. title: ClearToken Approved to Operate a Digital Securities Depository in the Bank of England's Digital Securities Sandbox
summary:
ClearToken CSD Limited, part of ClearToken’s digital financial market infrastructure group, has been approved by the Bank of England to operate a Digital Securities Depository (DSD) in the Digital Securities Sandbox (DSS). The approval, known as “Gate 2”, allows ClearToken CSD to issue and settle tokenised versions of existing securities under the Bank's supervision under certain limits. The approval means that ClearToken CSD becomes:
The first DSD approved to settle tokenised equities and corporate bonds, alongside sovereign debt.
The second firm to pass Gate 2, and the first non-bank.
The first cloud-native securities settlement system in the UK.
The first FMI to bridge traditional and 24/7 tokenised securities markets.
The first FMI to support intraday repo on a 24/7 basis.
Enabling 24/7 collateral mobilisation and intraday repo
The approval delivers to UK markets a regulated, neutral post-trade infrastructure through which tokenised securities can be settled, mobilised as collateral and financed around the clock. This enables an institutional market-first: the ability to settle repo intraday on a 24/7 basis. This means that institutions no longer need to rely on batch processes and end-of-day cut-offs. With settlement available throughout the day, participants can borrow against collateral for hours rather than days, reducing the cost of financing. ClearToken CSD’s model ensures fungibility between digital and traditional securities by using the same ISINs, ensuring that liquidity is not fragmented and that users’ rights are always preserved.
Phased roadmap of collateral activation
At launch, ClearToken CSD's live settlement services will support FTSE 350 equities, GBP government debt, and GBP and Non-GBP corporate bonds, allowing all to be used as collateral for securities financing transactions.
Subject to further approval from the Bank of England, ClearToken CSD intends to expand eligibility in phases to additional asset classes including global public equities, private funds, and physical commodities (such as gold) and digital assets.
This will amplify institutional collateral management on their existing architecture. With ClearToken CSD, an institution could hold an asset it already owns, whether a security, commodity or a money market fund unit, in a single legal form carrying an ISIN that settles 24/7 and books directly into the collateral and treasury systems the institution already runs.
Ben Santos-Stephens, CEO of ClearToken Group, said: “Our approval to operate a live DSD is hugely significant for the market. The biggest hurdle for institutional adoption of digital securities has not necessarily been the technology; it has been whether the infrastructure around that technology is sufficiently regulated, robust and legally recognised. Banks, asset managers and other market participants can now have confidence that digital securities can operate within a trusted, regulated post-trade framework alongside traditional financial assets.”
Akash Sharma, Head of Policy & Regulatory Affairs at ClearToken Group, said: “The UK has turned a tokenisation framework into a live, supervised market infrastructure where regulated institutions can settle assets carrying real rights. Institutions take their certainty from a rulebook, default arrangements and a named, accountable operator standing behind the ledger. That is what ClearToken CSD provides."
“We thank the Bank of England and the Financial Conduct Authority for a rigorous and proportionate process, and for their engagement throughout. Today's approval is evidence of the UK's commitment to innovation in financial markets.”
Ben Santos-Stephens, CEO of ClearToken Group, added: "The missing piece in tokenisation was never asset issuance, it was the market infrastructure behind it. Settlement, collateral mobility, and payments are the pillars that enable real-world adoption. Today, ClearToken is uniquely positioned, holding UK permissions for all three, with the cash leg already authorised, helping bridge the gap between digital innovation and regulated financial markets."
ClearToken’s unique horizontal clearing and settlement model
ClearToken is building a single post-trade service for tokenised assets across three regulated entities, bringing fragmented offerings into one integrated, neutral service for clients covering settlement of the securities leg, movement of cash, and clearing of financing trades and derivatives.
Each of the three has now reached a regulatory milestone: ClearToken Depository Limited is authorised as an Authorised Payment Institution regulated by the FCA and a registered cryptoasset firm, settling fiat, stablecoins and cryptoassets; ClearToken CSD Limited has passed Gate 2 and will operate as a Digital Securities Depository; and, ClearToken CCP Limited has submitted its application to the Bank of England for authorisation as a central counterparty.

This approval allows ClearToken to issue and settle tokenised equities, corporate bonds, and sovereign debt under regulatory supervision. The milestone enables 24/7 collateral mobilisation and intraday repo, bridging traditional financial markets with digital asset infrastructure.

title: HSBC and Conferma Expand Collaboration to Simplify B2B Payments Across Asia Pacific
summary:
HSBC and Conferma have expanded their long-standing-collaboration into Asia Pacific, enabling businesses to embed virtual card payments directly into procurement, travel, and supplier workflows. 
The move directly addresses growing demand from businesses for simpler payments and deeper integration with existing finance and procurement systems. Now, HSBC Virtual Cards can be embedded into finance, procurement, and payment processes, enabling customers to initiate and manage payments without leaving their existing operating environment. This reduces friction, improves control, and supports growing demand for more ‘invisible’ payment experiences.
The expansion marks the next phase of a -collaboration spanning more than a decade, which began in 2011 with virtual card deployment for corporate travel and has since evolved to support a broader range of B2B use cases. Now, that capability is being extended across Asia Pacific markets including Hong Kong, Singapore, and Malaysia.
As businesses increasingly operate in digital-first environments, embedded payments are becoming a strategic priority, with total transaction value projected to hit $228bn by 2028. Organisations are looking to eliminate manual processes, improve transparency, and enhance working capital management, while maintaining control within existing systems. Virtual cards are emerging as a critical tool in this transition, enabling finance teams to automate reconciliation, capture rich transaction data, and manage spend in real time.
The solution supports a range of use cases, including:
Frictionless travel payments: enabling hotel bookings to be settled seamlessly, removing manual billback, and streamlining reconciliation
Embedded supplier payments: integrating into procurement and finance workflows to enable faster, controlled transactions 
Enhanced visibility and control: providing real-time insight into spend and transaction-level data
Adam Williams, Head of Commercial – APAC at Conferma said: “Businesses across Asia are rethinking how they manage spend as digital transformation accelerates. Our collaboration with HSBC helps more businesses reduce manual intervention, improve reconciliation, and gain greater visibility over spend across both supplier and travel payments – all without disrupting existing processes.”
 Erika Yeung, Head of Commercial Cards, Asia Pacific at HSBC added: “Across Asia Pacific, customers are looking to modernise supplier payments to reduce manual processing, strengthen control, and optimise working capital. Virtual Cards are becoming a mainstream B2B payment method, extending well beyond T&E spend. By working with Conferma, we enable clients to embed automated Virtual Card payment workflows into their existing ERP, procurement, and AP platforms—improving straight-through processing and visibility.”

title: SurePay Appoints Robert Soetens as Chief Product Officer
summary:
SurePay, a leader in payment verification and fraud prevention, today announced the appointment of Robert Soetens as Chief Product Officer (CPO). Soetens will lead the growth of the company’s fraud risk intelligence platform, built on the payment verification network the company has operated since 2016. That network reaches more than 4,500 banks and 30,000 businesses globally.  
 
Alongside this appointment, SurePay co-founder Marcel Rienties takes on the newly created role of Chief Innovation Officer. Rienties will focus on where fraud goes next, Soetens on the platform that meets it. 
 

David-Jan Janse, CEO, said: "Verification stops a payment reaching the wrong account. What customers need now is to know whether the payee should be trusted at all and that is what we are building towards, spotting malicious payees before money moves and sharing what we see back with our community. We built SurePay around a simple idea, that a payment should always reach the right person, first time. Robert is the right leader to take that from national schemes to a global network. We're thrilled to welcome him to the team.” 
 

Robert Soetens said: "What drew me to SurePay was the strength of the foundation already in place, a unique network and data position that very few fraud prevention companies have. That is a rare thing to inherit, and it means we don't have to reinvent the wheel to grow, we just have to build on what’s here the right way. My focus now is turning that network into something smarter. It sees payment behaviour that no single institution can see on its own, and our platform turns that into risk signals banks can act on. The ambition is simple. Stop fraud before money moves.” 
 
Soetens joins at a point of rising pressure across the payments industry. According to the UK Finance’s 2026 Annual Fraud Report, payment fraud losses across the UK banking sector reached £1.28 billion in 2025, up 4% year-over-year. Authorised Push Payment (APP) fraud, where victims are manipulated into paying criminals themselves, rose 19% to £576.4 million, with case volumes up 7% to 248,070. Industry estimates suggest roughly eight people are defrauded every minute in the UK alone. 
 
Soetens joins SurePay from Backbase, the digital banking platform company, where he spent seven years at the company in senior product leadership roles, most recently as Vice President of Product

title: Mangopay Launches Echo to Give Platforms More Flexibility and Control over Multi-PSP Payment Flows
summary:
Mangopay, the wallet-first payment infrastructure for enterprise platforms, has introduced Echo, a new solution that enables businesses to centralize and manage payments processed by their existing PSPs in one single place for reconciliation, wallet allocation, splits, and payouts.
A response to payments complexity
Platforms work with multiple PSPs to serve different markets, offer local payment methods, and improve acceptance rates. However, rising transaction volumes and multiple providers make the post-acceptance journey too fragmented.  Information becomes trapped across separate systems, reports, and settlement processes.
Echo allows platforms to keep their existing PSP setups undistrupted while managing through Mangopay what happens post-payment, establishing one clear record of where funds are, who they belong to, and when they can be released to the right user’s account. PSPs continue to process pay-ins, while Mangopay’s infrastructure becomes the point from which the platform manages downstream money movement.
“Scaling platforms operate in a large and competitive landscape, with more providers to choose from as per their payments needs. Yet they pay for being spoiled for choice with operational costs and inefficiency. Each new payment provider means another reconciliation process, or another data structure that platforms need to adapt to. We built Echo to break that pattern and give platforms a flexible way to reduce operational costs from managing payment flows through multiple providers, while preserving their freedom to choose the providers that best support their business strategy,” said Andy Wiggan, Mangopay’s Chief Product Officer.
A new model for money movement in the platform economy
Echo represents a shift in how enterprise platforms can organize their payments operations. According to a recent Mangopay research, 86% of enterprise platforms still rely on manual reconciliation, while 30% identified better visibility over money flows as the improvement that would have the biggest impact on their payment operations. Mangopay has been supporting platforms in meeting these challenges that come with multi-party flows for over a decade, and continues its mission now offering platforms even more flexibility and control.
For the platform economy, launching Echo marks a move away from provider-dependent payment setups towards a more scalable model. The payment providers keep their role in payment acceptance, and the platforms keep control of how money is moved between users, partners, and their own business.

title: Cipher Mining Expands AI Data Center Push With ERCOT Capacity And Long-Term Lease
summary: TL;DR Cipher Mining disclosed conditional ERCOT interconnection capacity for up to 300 MW. The company also reported a 15-year hyperscaler master lease tied to HPC data-center infrastructure. The SEC filing does not identify the hyperscaler tenant by name. Cipher Mining is pushing further into high-performance computing and AI infrastructure, using the power assets built around its mining business as a platform for longer-term data-center contracts. A September 21 SEC filing outlines conditional ERCOT interconnection capacity for up to 300 MW alongside a 15-year hyperscaler master lease. Cipher Looks Beyond Pure Bitcoin Mining The combination matters because power access has become one of the most valuable assets in both Bitcoin mining and AI data centers. Mining companies already control large power connections, land and electrical infrastructure. As demand from AI workloads increases, some operators are trying to convert part of that footprint into higher-value hosting arrangements. Cipher’s filing places it firmly inside that trend. The 300 MW figure refers to conditional ERCOT interconnection capacity, while the 15-year term applies to the disclosed hyperscaler master lease. The Tenant Remains Undisclosed One detail should not be filled in with speculation. The SEC filing does not name the hyperscaler tenant, so attaching a specific technology company to the agreement would go beyond the source. That leaves the strategic direction as the more useful part of the story: Cipher is building an infrastructure business that can serve computing demand beyond Bitcoin mining. For miners, long-term data-center leases can also change the revenue profile by reducing dependence on Bitcoin price and network difficulty. The September 21 filing does not mean mining disappears from Cipher’s business. It shows the company is increasingly trying to monetize the same power and site-development capabilities across both crypto and AI/HPC markets. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae. Source: Primary Source
content: Cipher Mining has expanded its push into AI and high-performance computing data centers by securing conditional ERCOT interconnection capacity for up to 300 MW. The company also announced a 15-year hyperscaler master lease for HPC infrastructure. While the SEC filing does not name the tenant, the move highlights how Bitcoin mining companies are leveraging their valuable power and site assets to tap into broader computing demand.

summary: Ripple pioneer David Schwartz calls out the latest XRP army rumors, reminding fans that his casual jokes aren't hidden market signals.
content: Ripple pioneer David Schwartz has dismissed recent rumors circulating within the XRP community. He urged fans to stop overanalyzing his casual remarks and lighthearted jokes, clarifying that they do not contain any hidden market signals or secret predictions about the cryptocurrency's future price.
content_ta: Ripple நிறுவனத்தின் முன்னோடியான David Schwartz, XRP சமூகத்தில் பரவி வரும் வதந்திகளை மறுத்துள்ளார். அவரது சாதாரண நகைச்சுவைகளை சந்தை குறிப்புகளாக பார்க்க வேண்டாம் என்றும், அவை எத்தகைய ரகசிய குறிிகளையும் கொண்டிருக்கவில்லை என்றும் அவர் ரசிகர்களை கேட்டுக்கொண்டுள்ளார்.

title: Moxie Marlinspike launches Confer, a privacy-focused AI chatbot with end-to-end encryption
summary:
Confer's launch challenges AI industry norms, prioritizing user privacy over data monetization, potentially reshaping digital communication.
The post Moxie Marlinspike launches Confer, a privacy-focused AI chatbot with end-to-end encryption appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Moxie Marlinspike has launched Confer, a new privacy-focused AI chatbot that features end-to-end encryption. This release challenges standard industry practices by prioritizing user privacy and data protection over data monetization, which could potentially reshape the future of secure digital communication.
content_ta: Moxie Marlinspike, end-to-end encryption வசதியுடன் கூடிய தனியுரிமையை மையமாகக் கொண்ட Confer என்ற புதிய AI chatbot-ஐ அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. தரவுப் பணமாக்கலை விட பயனர்களின் தனியுரிமைக்கு முன்னுரிமை அளிப்பதன் மூலம் இந்த வெளியீடு தொழில் துறை வழக்கங்களை சவால் செய்கிறது, இது டிஜிட்டல் தொடர்பாடலை மாற்றியமைக்கலாம்.

title: New Jersey Financial Advisor Steals $300,000 From Elderly Client, Gets Seven-Year Prison Term
summary:
A Verona financial advisor received a seven-year prison sentence after draining more than $300,000 from a 90-year-old client's accounts.
The post New Jersey Financial Advisor Steals $300,000 From Elderly Client, Gets Seven-Year Prison Term appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: A New Jersey financial advisor from Verona was sentenced to seven years in prison for stealing over $300,000 from a 90-year-old client's accounts. The advisor drained the elderly client's funds before being caught and prosecuted for the financial fraud.
content_ta: Verona-வைச் சேர்ந்த New Jersey நிதி ஆலோசகர் ஒருவர், 90 வயது முதியவரின் கணக்கிலிருந்து $300,000-க்கும் அதிகமான தொகையைத் திருடிய வழக்கில் ஏழு ஆண்டுகள் சிறை தண்டனை பெற்றுள்ளார். நிதி மோசடியில் ஈடுபட்ட இந்த ஆலோசகர் மீது உரிய நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டு தண்டனை வழங்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Getting Monero without an exchange account in 2026
summary:
Several large exchanges removed Monero from 2024 onward, some everywhere and some for part of their users. Since early 2024, several big exchanges have removed it, some for all users and some for part of their user base. For many holders, the practical question is now how to get Monero without an exchange account, and […]
The post Getting Monero without an exchange account in 2026 appeared first on CoinJournal.
content: From 2024 onward, several major cryptocurrency exchanges began delisting Monero entirely or for specific user bases. This trend has left many holders seeking alternative methods to acquire the privacy-focused cryptocurrency without relying on traditional exchange accounts as the landscape shifts toward 2026.
content_ta: 2024 முதல், பல முக்கிய கிரிப்டோகரன்சி எக்ஸ்சேஞ்சுகள் Monero-வை முழுமையாகவோ அல்லது குறிப்பிட்ட பயனர்களுக்கோ நீக்கத் தொடங்கின. இந்த மாற்றத்தால், பாரம்பரிய எக்ஸ்சேஞ்ச் கணக்குகளைப் பயன்படுத்தாமல் Monero-வைப் பெறுவதற்கான மாற்று வழிகளைப் பல முதலீட்டாளர்கள் தேடி வருகின்றனர்.

title: Russian fintech A7 exploited Swift controls to funnel billion of dollars in sanctioned payments
summary: An FT investigation has uncoverd a massive money laundering scam conducted by Kremlin-controlled fintech A7 that tricked international banks into handling billions of dollars in sanction-busting payments to Russian state companies.
content: An investigation has uncovered a major financial scheme involving the Kremlin-controlled fintech A7. The company reportedly exploited Swift messaging controls to deceive international banks, successfully funneling billions of dollars in sanction-busting payments for Russian state companies.
content_ta: கிரெம்ளின் கட்டுப்பாட்டில் உள்ள fintech நிறுவனமான A7, Swift கட்டுப்பாடுகளைத் பயன்படுத்தி சர்வதேச வங்கிகளை ஏமாற்றி, ரஷ்ய அரசு நிறுவனங்களுக்கு பல பில்லியன் டாலர் மதிப்பிலான தடை செய்யப்பட்ட தொகையை அனுப்பியதாக விசாரணையில் தெரியவந்துள்ளது.

title: CellPoint appoints new leadership and secures $34m from Toscafund
summary: CellPoint today announces a new leadership team, a US$34 million investment from Toscafund, managed by its PE affiliate Penta Capital, and the launch of Zenith, its AI decisioning platform for airline and hospitality payments.
content: CellPoint has announced a new leadership team alongside a US$34 million investment from Toscafund, managed by Penta Capital. Additionally, the company launched Zenith, a new artificial intelligence decisioning platform designed specifically for airline and hospitality payments. This funding and restructuring aim to drive further growth and innovation in the payment solutions sector.
content_ta: CellPoint தனது புதிய தலைமையை அறிவித்துள்ளதுடன், Penta Capital-ன் நிர்வகிப்பில் இருக்கும் Toscafund நிறுவனத்திடமிருந்து US$34 மில்லியன் முதலீட்டைப் பெற்றுள்ளது. மேலும், விமான மற்றும் விருந்தோம்பல் துறை கட்டணங்களுக்காக Zenith என்ற புதிய AI இயங்குதளத்தையும் இந்நிறுவனம் அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: How financial firms can get more value from employee experience data
summary: Author: A finextra community member
content: Financial institutions can significantly improve their operations by leveraging employee experience data. By effectively gathering and analyzing feedback and workplace insights from staff, firms can identify key areas for improvement, boost morale, and drive overall organizational value. Prioritizing the employee journey enables companies to build stronger, more resilient workplace cultures in a competitive financial sector.
content_ta: நிதி நிறுவனங்கள் தங்கள் ஊழியர்களின் அனுபவ தரவுகளை சரியாகப் பயன்படுத்துவதன் மூலம் செயல்பாடுகளை மேம்படுத்த முடியும். பணியாளர்களின் கருத்துக்களை சேகரித்து பகுப்பாய்வு செய்வதன் மூலம், நிறுவனங்கள் முன்னேற்றத்திற்கான பகுதிகளை அடையாளம் கண்டு, அவர்களின் உத்வேகத்தை உயர்த்தலாம். ஊழியர்களின் தேவைகளுக்கு முன்னுரிமை அளிப்பது போட்டி நிறைந்த நிதித்துறையில் வலுவான கலாச்சாரத்தை உருவாக்க உதவும்.

title: A $3.2 million 'bitcoin butterfly' option trade bets on $95,000 by the end of October
summary:
Institutional interest in Bitcoin options suggests potential for significant market movement, possibly triggering a gamma squeeze if prices rise.
The post $3.2M bitcoin butterfly option trade targets $95,000 by end of October appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A significant $3.2 million Bitcoin butterfly option trade has been placed, targeting a price of $95,000 by the end of October. This large institutional move highlights growing interest in Bitcoin derivatives and indicates potential for major market volatility, which could trigger a gamma squeeze if prices continue to rise in the coming weeks.
content_ta: அக்டோபர் மாத இறுதிக்குள் $95,000 விலையை இலக்காகக் கொண்டு $3.2 மில்லியன் மதிப்பிலான மிகப்பெரிய Bitcoin பட்டர்ஃபிளை ஆப்ஷன் வர்த்தகம் செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த நிறுவன முதலீட்டாளர்களின் நடவடிக்கை Bitcoin வழி생ப் பொருட்களின் மீதான ஆர்வத்தை அதிகரிப்பதைக் காட்டுகிறது, மேலும் விலை தொடர்ந்து உயர்ந்தால் சந்தையில் பெரிய மாற்றங்கள் ஏற்பட வாய்ப்புள்ளது.

title: Binance buys $100 million Circle stake in five-year USDC promotion deal
summary:
The potential deepening of Binance-Circle ties could reshape stablecoin market dynamics, intensifying competition with Tether's USDT.
The post Circle secures $100 million from Binance in expanded USDC deal: SEC filing appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Binance has acquired a $100 million stake in Circle as part of a major five-year promotional agreement centered around the USDC stablecoin. According to regulatory filings, this strategic collaboration aims to deepen ties between the two entities and could significantly shift market dynamics within the stablecoin industry, increasing competition against rival tokens like Tether's USDT.
content_ta: USDC தொடர்பான ஐந்து ஆண்டு விளம்பர ஒப்பந்தத்தின் ஒரு பகுதியாக, Circle நிறுவனத்தில் 100 மில்லியன் டாலர் பங்குகளை Binance வாங்கியுள்ளது. ஒழுங்குமுறை ஆவணங்களின்படி, இந்த மூலோபக மற்றும் வணிக ஒத்துழைப்பு stablecoin சந்தையில் இரு நிறுவனங்களுக்கு இடையேயான உறவை ஆழப்படுத்தவும், Tether-ன் USDT போன்ற பிற போட்டி டோக்கன்களுக்கு எதிரான போட்டியை தீவிரப்படுத்தவும் உதவும்.

title: Bitcoin recovers from Asian-session lows as falling oil price supports risk appetite
summary: Bitcoin traded near $86,000 as WTI crude dropped below $90 and strong stock markets supported risk appetite.
content: Bitcoin recovered from its earlier Asian-session lows, trading near $86,000 as declining oil prices provided a boost to broader market sentiment. West Texas Intermediate crude dropped below $90 a barrel, easing inflation concerns. Strong performance across stock markets further supported risk appetite, helping the leading cryptocurrency regain positive momentum following recent volatility.
content_ta: ஆசிய நேர வர்த்தகத்தின் தொடக்க சரிவிலிருந்து மீண்ட Bitcoin, ஏறக்குறைய $86,000 விலையில் வர்த்தகமானது. கச்சா எண்ணெய் விலை சரிவு மற்றும் பங்குச் சந்தைகளின் வலிமையான செயல்பாடு ஆகியவை முதலீட்டாளர்களின் ரிஸ்க் எடுக்கும் ஆர்வத்திற்கு ஆதரவளித்தன. இதனால் கடந்த சில நாட்களாக நிலவிய விலை மந்தநிலைக்குப் பிறகு முன்னணி கிரிப்டோகரன்சி மீண்டும் நேர்மறையான போக்கைப் பெற்றது.

title: Live updates: Oil falls as Iran signals possible Hormuz reopening, bitcoin holds near $86,000
summary: WTI crude oil drops to $89 as reports suggest Iran could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.
content: Crude oil prices fell, with WTI dropping to $89 per barrel following reports that Iran may reopen the Strait of Hormuz within a week. Meanwhile, bitcoin remained stable, holding steady near the $86,000 mark as global markets reacted to the developing geopolitical situation.
content_ta: கச்சா எண்ணெய் விலையானது சரிவடைந்துள்ளது. ஈரான் தரப்பில் Hormuz நீரிணை ஒரு வாரத்திற்குள் மீண்டும் திறக்கப்படலாம் என்ற தகவலை அடுத்து, WTI கச்சா எண்ணெய் $89 ஆகக் குறைந்துள்ளது. இதற்கிடையில், உலகளாவிய சந்தைகளின் நிலவரத்திற்கு ஏற்ப bitcoin விலையானது $86,000 என்ற நிலைக்கு அருகில் நிலையாக வர்த்தகமாகி வருகிறது.

title: ECB, EU cenbanks seek changes in MiCA’s minimum bank deposit for stablecoins
summary:
The ECB's proposal to replace MiCA's stablecoin reserve rule with liquidity-focused requirements could enhance financial stability and flexibility.
The post European Central Bank seeks to scrap MiCA’s stablecoin reserve rule appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: The European Central Bank and other European Union central banks are seeking changes to the MiCA framework regarding minimum bank deposits for stablecoins. The ECB proposes replacing the current reserve rule with liquidity-focused requirements to enhance overall financial stability and flexibility.
content_ta: MiCA விதிகளின் கீழ் உள்ள stablecoins குறைந்தபட்ச வங்கி வைப்புத்தொகை தொடர்பான விதிமுறைகளில் மாற்றங்களைச் செய்ய ECB மற்றும் EU central banks முயற்சித்து வருகின்றன. தற்போதைய reserve விதிகளுக்குப் பதிலாக liquidity-focused தேவைகளை அமல்படுத்த ECB பரிந்துரைத்துள்ளது.

title: Crypto metric signals altseason as Bitcoin market-cap share stalls below 60%
summary: Glassnode's indicator compares BTC with a market-cap-weighted basket of 250 altcoins, excluding stablecoins, to track relative performance.
content: A key crypto metric suggests an altseason may be approaching as Bitcoin's market-cap dominance stalls below the 60% threshold. According to data from Glassnode, the indicator tracks relative performance by comparing Bitcoin against a market-cap-weighted basket of 250 altcoins, excluding stablecoins. This shift in momentum highlights growing investor interest in alternative digital assets as the leading cryptocurrency's market share pauses its upward trajectory.
content_ta: Bitcoin-யின் மார்க்கெட்-கேப் பங்கு 60%-க்கு கீழே ஸ்தம்பித்துள்ளதால், விரைவில் altseason வரக்கூடும் என்று கிரிப்டோ அளவீடு சுட்டிக்காட்டுகிறது. Glassnode தரவுகளின்படி, இந்த காட்டி stablecoin-களைத் தவிர்த்து, 250 altcoin-களின் மார்க்கெட்-கேப்-weighted பாஸ்கெட்டுடன் Bitcoin-ஐ ஒப்பிட்டு ஒப்பீட்டு செயல்திறனைக் கண்காணிக்கிறது. முன்னணி கிரிப்டோகரன்சியின் மார்க்கெட் பங்கு தன் மேல்நோக்கிய பயணத்தை நிறுத்தி வைத்துள்ளதால், மாற்றுக் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களின் மீது முதலீட்டாளர்களின் ஆர்வம் அதிகரித்து வருவதை இந்த வேகம் காட்டுகிறது.

title: SoFi begins stablecoin settlement on Mastercard network for program expected to exceed $25 billion in annualized volume
summary: SoFi launches live SoFiUSD stablecoin settlement on Mastercard's network, with its card program targeting $25 billion in annualized volume.
content: SoFi has officially launched live stablecoin settlement using the SoFiUSD token on the Mastercard network. The newly initiated card program is anticipated to grow significantly, with projections expected to exceed $25 billion in annualized volume. This integration marks a major step forward for digital asset adoption in traditional payment systems.
content_ta: SoFi நிறுவனம் Mastercard நெட்வொர்க்கில் சோபிUSD (SoFiUSD) ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் செட்டில்மென்ட்டை அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாகத் தொடங்கியுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய கார்டு திட்டம் கணிசமாக வளர்ச்சியடையும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது, இதன் ஆண்டு பரிவர்த்தனை அளவு $25 பில்லியனைத் தாண்டும் என்று கணிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Bernstein sees annual prediction market volumes hitting $10 trillion by 2035 as financial assets overtake sports
summary: Bernstein projects global prediction market volume will hit $10 trillion by 2035, driven by expanding financial assets.
content: Investment firm Bernstein projects that global prediction market volumes will surge to $10 trillion annually by 2035. This massive growth is expected to be driven by a shift toward financial assets, which will eventually overtake traditional sports betting as the primary catalyst for market expansion within the prediction industry over the coming decade.
content_ta: 2035-க்குள் உலகளாவிய ப்டிக்சன் மார்க்கெட் வர்த்தகம் ஆண்டுதோறும் $10 டிரில்லியனை எட்டும் என்று Bernstein நிறுவனம் கணித்துள்ளது. விளையாட்டு பந்தயங்களை விஞ்சி நிதிசார் சொத்துக்கள் ஆதிக்கம் செலுத்துவதே இந்த அசுர வளர்ச்சிக்கு முக்கிய காரணமாக இருக்கும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: Contrarian Crypto Analyst Who Predicted 2026 Perfectly Calls for Caution and Q4 Crash
summary:
Bitcoin pushing back toward $86,000 has many retail traders convinced the bear market is dead and the bulls are back in full control. But Dan Krupka, founder of Connection Capital and former research head at Coin Bureau, sees something far uglier: the tail end of a textbook relief rally setting up a brutal liquidity trap […]

content: Despite Bitcoin pushing back toward $86,000 and renewing retail trader optimism, former Coin Bureau research head and Connection Capital founder Dan Krupka has issued a warning. title: Coincheck Group Confirms Executive Chairperson Change In SEC Filing
summary: TL;DR Coincheck Group disclosed that Executive Chairperson Takashi Oyagi resigned effective September 21. The company said the resignation was for personal reasons. The filing supports a leadership-transition story, not speculation about enforcement or financial distress. Coincheck Group has confirmed a change at the top of its leadership structure after Executive Chairperson Takashi Oyagi resigned. The crypto group disclosed the move in a September 21 Form 6-K filed with the US Securities and Exchange Commission. Oyagi Steps Down For Personal Reasons According to the filing, Oyagi’s resignation took effect on September 21 and was submitted for personal reasons. The board approved a leadership-transition structure following the resignation. That is the extent of what the filing supports. There is no basis in the disclosure for tying the move to regulatory enforcement, a financial crisis or a broader scandal, and those interpretations should not be attached to the change without separate evidence. Coincheck Enters A New Governance Phase Leadership changes at large crypto businesses can attract outsized attention because investors often look for hidden signals around strategy, regulation or balance-sheet conditions. In this case, the formal disclosure is comparatively straightforward. Coincheck Group has changed its executive-chairperson structure after Oyagi’s resignation, with the board putting the approved transition arrangements into effect. The filing provides a clean corporate-governance update rather than a market-moving operational announcement. What happens next will depend on how the new structure affects Coincheck’s strategic priorities, but the September 21 event itself is limited to the leadership change disclosed in the Form 6-K. title: Kalshi Files To Bring Perpetual Futures To US Stocks And ETFs
summary: TL;DR KalshiEX has filed proposed listing standards for perpetual security futures tied to 58 stocks and ETFs. The proposal was published on September 18 under SEC File No. SR-KALSHIEX-2026-02. The products are not live; CFTC approval is still pending. KalshiEX is seeking regulatory clearance for a product that would bring crypto-style perpetual futures mechanics into the US equity market. A rule filing published by the SEC under File No. SR-KALSHIEX-2026-02 proposes listing standards for perpetual security futures tied to 58 stocks and exchange-traded funds. Kalshi Targets Perpetual Exposure To Equities Perpetual futures are already a core part of crypto trading, where contracts can remain open without a fixed expiration date and use funding mechanisms to keep prices aligned with the underlying market. Applying a similar structure to US-listed stocks and ETFs would be a meaningful expansion of that model. Kalshi’s filing establishes the proposed framework, but it does not make the contracts available for trading immediately. The document explicitly notes that the CFTC has not yet approved the proposed rule change. Filing Is A Regulatory Step, Not A Product Launch That status is the most important limitation. The products are not live, and the September 18 filing should not be presented as evidence that US equity perpetuals have already started trading on Kalshi. Instead, the filing gives regulators and market participants a formal proposal to review. If ultimately approved, the structure could blur some of the traditional boundaries between prediction-market infrastructure, derivatives exchanges and crypto-style perpetual trading. For now, however, the confirmed story is procedural: KalshiEX has proposed perpetual security futures linked to 58 stocks and ETFs, and regulatory approval remains pending. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae. Source: Primary Source
content: Kalshi has submitted a regulatory filing to introduce perpetual security futures tied to 58 US stocks and ETFs. The proposal outlines bringing crypto-style perpetual futures mechanics, which lack fixed expiration dates, to traditional equities. However, the products are not currently live for trading. The filing serves as a formal proposal for review, and final approval from regulators remains pending.

title: MEXC Expands Opportunity Compass with Stock Trading Handbook to Help Crypto Users Build Investment Knowledge
summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, September 22, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, has expanded its Opportunity Compass education initiative by introducing the MEXC Stock Trading Handbook, a new guide designed to help crypto traders bridge the knowledge gap as they enter the stock market. The Handbook reflects a broader evolution in how MEXC empowers users, moving beyond access to Wall Street to help users understand the market, navigate trading tools, and build long-term trading systems.   Opportunity Compass is MEXC’s global markets education initiative, guided by the core message, “Know the Market, Know Your Opportunities,” and designed to help crypto-native users build a more systematic understanding of traditional and crypto markets. For users exploring stocks and other traditional markets, differences in market dynamics, asset behavior, trading tools, and strategies can create a learning curve. The Stock Trading Handbook extends this learning journey with a structured resource focused on stock markets, helping users build market knowledge and develop a more informed approach to stock trading.   The Handbook provides practical guidance across five key areas: Understand the Market: Helps crypto traders understand how stock markets work, from market opportunities and price reactions to differences in asset exposure and market dynamics. Choose the Right Trading Tools: Helps users understand how to approach the same stock through different trading tools, such as Stock Futures, RealStocks, and Tokenized Stocks. Adapt to Stock Market Rhythms: Covers stock-specific factors such as earnings, event-driven moves, gaps, liquidity, and volatility, helping users adapt their trading to how stock markets move. Apply the Right Playbook: Introduces practical playbooks across Momentum, Trend, Contrarian, Earnings, Event-Driven, Hedging, and Range & Grid strategies. Building a Trading System: Goes beyond individual trades to cover trade management, position management, review, and journaling, helping users develop a more structured trading system that fits their own trading preferences.   Beyond Opportunity Compass, MEXC has also introduced a series of initiatives to help users break down traditional barriers to financial markets and pursue infinite opportunities. Its recent Trade Wall Street, Without Walls campaign addressed five traditional barriers to market participation, including the Access Wall, Fee Wall, Time Wall, Capital Wall, and Direction Wall, making traditional market participation more accessible. MEXC also introduced MEXC Wall Street DNA to help users identify their trading preferences. Together, these initiatives help users move from accessing stock markets and understanding their own trading preferences to building the knowledge and strategies needed to navigate different markets.   The digital edition of the MEXC Stock Trading Handbook is now available for download from MEXC. In addition, a limited physical edition will also be distributed at TOKEN2049 Singapore.   About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway.   With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity.   MEXC Official Website｜ X ｜ Telegram ｜How to Sign Up on MEXC For media inquiries, please contact MEXC PR team: media@mexc.com   Risk Disclaimer: This content does not constitute investment advice. Given the volatility of financial markets, including digital assets, tokenized assets, and traditional financial products, investors should carefully assess market conditions, underlying asset fundamentals, and potential financial risks before making any investment or trading decisions. Source

title: CellPoint Appoints New Leadership and Secures $34M from Toscafund to Launch Zenith, Its AI Decisioning Platform for Airline and Hospitality Payments
summary:
CellPoint today announces a new leadership team, a US$34 million investment from Toscafund, managed by its PE affiliate Penta Capital, and the launch of Zenith, its AI decisioning platform for airline and hospitality payments.
Penta Capital has appointed Kevin Murphy as Group CEO and Michael Kelly as Chairman. Their brief is to transform CellPoint and build the AI-led payments platform in the core markets of Airlines & Hospitality, two industries where payments directly shape margin, revenue and resilience.
"Payments are one of the largest controllable cost and revenue lines in an airline or hotel P&L, and one of the least well managed," said Kevin Murphy, Group CEO. "Our job is to change that. Zenith uses AI to raise approval rates, cut cost of payments, recover lost revenue and give CFOs a live view of what their payment stack is actually doing. The $34m investment lets us build it at pace."
"CellPoint has the data, the customers and the technology to lead this category, we have been given a clear mandate: focus the company, invest in AI, and deliver measurable financial impact for our airline and hospitality customers. Zenith is how we do it."
Zenith is an AI decisioning layer that sits above any payment orchestrator – CellPoint's own or a third party's – turning payment data into automated commercial decisions. Airlines and hotels can adopt Zenith without replacing their existing payment stack.
The Toscafund investment also funds 50 new roles in product, data, AI, sales and partnerships across Europe, the Americas and Asia, and a strengthened executive team including Patrick Uckermark as Chief Product and Technology Officer, leading the AI and data roadmap.
Steven Scott, Managing Partner at Penta Capital, added: "We backed the team and the plan. Kevin and Michael have the experience to transform CellPoint and the discipline to turn AI into measurable financial results for airlines and hotels. Zenith is a genuinely differentiated position in a category that matters. Our US$34m reflects our confidence in that outcome."

The funds will also support the creation of new roles across multiple regions to accelerate product development and global expansion.

title: BVNK Expands Multi-Chain Stablecoin Infrastructure with Stellar Integration
summary:
BVNK today announced the integration of the Stellar blockchain into its stablecoin payments platform, giving businesses access to another high-speed, low-cost payment rail through BVNK’s single platform and API.
The integration brings together leading stablecoin infrastructure provider BVNK, which processes $39B in annualized volume, and Stellar, the network which processed $55.6B in payment volume in 2025. It gives BVNK’s customers an additional route for moving stablecoins globally, while enabling businesses to access multiple blockchain networks through a single API. This abstracts much of the technical complexity of connecting to individual blockchain networks.  
BVNK’s customers can now access Stellar’s network for high-volume cross-border payments, merchant payouts, and treasury disbursements. Stellar is one of the world's most established payment-focused blockchain networks, specifically designed for digital asset transfers and global payments. Stellar has an average settlement speed of 5 seconds, 99.99% network uptime and average transaction costs are a fraction of a cent. 
The integration reflects BVNK’s multi-chain, multi-coin approach to stablecoin payments. By bringing this established network on to its platform, BVNK will offer payments teams another high-efficiency settlement route, all through a single integration. BVNK acts as the infrastructure layer connecting the stablecoin ecosystem, abstracting underlying blockchain complexity so businesses can access new rails without the engineering burden of building separate integrations or re-platforming as they scale.
This integration, which connects BVNK customers to Stellar today, can also be extended to additional Stellar-native assets over time as BVNK adds support for them – without additional work needed on the customer's side. 
Kim Mescal Julien, Head of Partnerships at BVNK, said: “The future of global payments is multi-chain and multi-asset, but businesses shouldn't have to manage the underlying engineering burden of connecting to dozens of individual blockchains. 
“By integrating Stellar’s established payment network, we are giving our customers another efficient, low-cost route to move money globally through a single platform and API. Businesses can choose the networks and assets that best fit their needs, without having to build and maintain the infrastructure to connect to each one themselves.”
Denelle Dixon, CEO & Executive Director of the Stellar Development Foundation said: “Businesses moving money at scale need to know it works every time, in every corridor. Stellar has spent a decade building a payments network that financial institutions and regulated enterprises depend on for cross-border transfers, payouts, and stablecoin settlement. Stellar is a network financial institutions trust and now BVNK's customers will have access to the Stellar network's reliable payment rails."
The integration further expands BVNK’s role as infrastructure connecting businesses to the stablecoin ecosystem, giving customers access to a growing range of networks and assets through a single platform. 
The Stellar integration is live today for all BVNK enterprise customers across 130+ supported countries.
